load_sim_config: load the simulation config for a quadruped robot environment with rendering enabled or disabled
add_random_push_config: add a random push randomizer with horizontal and vertical force bounds to the locomotion gym environment
select_gait: select a gait pattern like fast_trot, slow_trot, or walk and return stance duration, duty factor, and initial phase
setup_controller: setup a locomotion controller for a robot with a specified gait, swing leg controller, and stance leg controller
review_constants: review the module-level constants including motor KD gains, body height, inertia scale, and max time seconds
